question: Calculate the percentage of players who prefer the left foot at least once across all available season records and were born between 1987 and 1992.
final_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(any_left) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_left_foot FROM (SELECT P.player_fifa_api_id, MAX(CASE WHEN PA.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_left FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992 GROUP BY P.player_fifa_api_id) AS t

question: Calculate Elijah Allen’s average spend per event for events in September and October
final_sql: SELECT AVG(event_total_spend) AS average_spend_per_event FROM ( SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(e.cost) AS event_total_spend FROM expense AS e JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah' AND m.last_name = 'Allen' AND SUBSTR(e.expense_date, 6, 2) IN ('09', '10') GROUP BY b.link_to_event ) AS per_event;

question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
final_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id) AS avg_up_votes, CAST(SUM(T1.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id) AS avg_user_age FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT P.OwnerUserId FROM posts AS P GROUP BY P.OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(P.OwnerUserId) > 10 ) AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

question: State all the tags used by Mark Meckes in his posts that doesn't have comments.
final_sql: WITH RECURSIVE split(post_id, rest, tag) AS ( SELECT p.Id, p.Tags, substr(p.Tags, 2, instr(p.Tags, '>') - 2) FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.CommentCount = 0 AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL AND p.Tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT post_id, substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1), substr(substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1), 2, instr(substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1), '>') - 2) FROM split WHERE rest LIKE '%>%' ) SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM split WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> '' ORDER BY tag

question: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
final_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos')
